WSBs refers to a Reddit forum community focused on speculative trading. WSBs is associated with coordinated buying of heavily shorted stocks that produced a short squeeze in early 2021.

Cashtag piggybacking is the practice of adding the cashtag of a popular asset to social media posts about a different asset. Cashtag piggybacking aims to draw trader attention to a low-volume asset. Cashtag piggybacking is associated with pump-and-dump schemes.

Sandwich attacks are a form of extractable value exploitation on blockchains. Sandwich attacks place one transaction before and one after a victim's trade within the same block. Sandwich attacks profit from the price slippage caused by the victim's trade.
